//! OmniNode fixture generator for `pool_getUnit` / `pool_getOffer` (#130).
//!
//! NOT part of sum-chain: run from a scratch checkout of the pool-read commit
//! to record what the real JSON-RPC server answers, over HTTP, for state built
//! with the real model and store operations (the same harness as
//! `pool_read_rpcs.rs`, copied verbatim). Two modes:
//!
//! * `POOL_FIXTURE_OUT=<dir>`: write each HTTP response body to `<dir>`.
//! * `POOL_SERVE_READY=<file>` (+ `POOL_SERVE_STOP=<file>`): serve the seeded
//!   state over HTTP, write the URL to the ready file, and keep serving until
//!   the stop file exists (at most 10 minutes).

#![allow(dead_code, unused_imports)]

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, HashMap};
use std::sync::Arc;

use sumchain_consensus::PoAEngine;
use sumchain_crypto::KeyPair;
use sumchain_genesis::{ChainParams, Genesis};
use sumchain_primitives::{Address, Block, BlockHeader, Hash};
use sumchain_rpc::api::SumChainApiServer;
use sumchain_rpc::server::RpcServer;
use sumchain_rpc::types::{
    PoolAcceptedLeafInfo, PoolAssignmentInfo, PoolOfferInfo, PoolRequiredInputInfo,
    PoolReservationInfo, PoolUnitInfo,
};
use sumchain_state::compute_pool::{
    AcceptedLeaf, AssignmentIndexEntry, BondedOffer, CommitBondId, ComputePoolModel,
    ExposureInputs, JobId, OfferBondId, RequiredInput, SlotId, UnitId, UnitKey, UnitSizing,
    UnitState, WorkItemKey, WorkUnit,
};
use sumchain_state::compute_pool_store::{
    active_offer_index_key_bytes, offer_key_bytes, reservation_key_bytes, unit_key_bytes,
    ComputePoolStore,
};
use sumchain_state::{Mempool, MempoolConfig, StateManager};
use sumchain_storage::candidate::{
    BlockJournals, CandidateExecution, ExecutionSubject, JournalRecord,
};
use sumchain_storage::{cf, Database};
use tempfile::TempDir;
use tokio::sync::mpsc;

const INVALID_PARAMS: i32 = -32602;
const INTERNAL: i32 = -32603;

fn server() -> (RpcServer, Arc<Database>, TempDir) {
    let dir = TempDir::new().unwrap();
    let db = Arc::new(Database::open_default(dir.path()).unwrap());
    let state = Arc::new(StateManager::new(db.clone(), 1));
    let mempool = Arc::new(Mempool::new(MempoolConfig::default()));
    let validator = KeyPair::from_bytes([0x51; 32]);
    // The production default: the pool gate is closed.
    let genesis = Genesis::new(
        1,
        0,
        vec![validator.public_key().to_base58()],
        HashMap::from([(validator.address().to_base58(), 1u128)]),
        ChainParams::default(),
    );
    let engine = Arc::new(
        PoAEngine::new(
            db.clone(),
            state.clone(),
            mempool.clone(),
            &genesis,
            Some(validator),
        )
        .unwrap(),
    );
    let (tx_sender, _rx) = mpsc::channel(8);
    let srv = RpcServer::new(
        db.clone(),
        state,
        mempool,
        engine,
        tx_sender,
        Arc::new(|| 0usize),
    );
    (srv, db, dir)
}

fn jid(b: u8) -> JobId {
    JobId::from_bytes([b; 32])
}
fn uid(b: u8) -> UnitId {
    UnitId::from_bytes([b; 32])
}
fn oid(b: u8) -> OfferBondId {
    OfferBondId::from_bytes([b; 32])
}
fn addr(b: u8) -> Address {
    Address::new([b; 20])
}
fn hex32(b: u8) -> String {
    format!("0x{}", hex::encode([b; 32]))
}

fn unit(job: JobId, u: UnitId) -> WorkUnit {
    WorkUnit {
        job_id: job,
        unit_id: u,
        predecessors: vec![],
        required_inputs: vec![],
        generation: 0,
        state: UnitState::Blocked,
    }
}

fn offer(id: OfferBondId, identity: Address, active: bool) -> BondedOffer {
    BondedOffer {
        offer_bond_id: id,
        identity,
        payment_addr: addr(0x50),
        offered_bytes: 1_000,
        offer_seq: 3,
        bond_locked: 500,
        active,
    }
}

/// Job 1 with three units:
/// * unit 2: assigned to offer 3 and accepted (leaf with commit bond 4);
/// * unit 3: assigned to offer 3, not accepted;
/// * unit 4: blocked on unit 2, with one required input.
///
/// Offer 3 is active with a reservation; offer 5 is inactive, with none.
fn model() -> ComputePoolModel {
    let mut m = ComputePoolModel::new();
    let j = jid(1);
    let mut u4 = unit(j, uid(4));
    u4.predecessors = vec![uid(2)];
    u4.required_inputs = vec![RequiredInput {
        predecessor: uid(2),
        required_output_slot_id: SlotId::from_bytes([0x21; 32]),
        pred_output_manifest_root: Hash::new([0x22; 32]),
        required_slot_state_object_root: Hash::new([0x23; 32]),
    }];
    let units = vec![unit(j, uid(2)), unit(j, uid(3)), u4];
    let sizing: Vec<UnitSizing> = units.iter().map(|_| UnitSizing { slots: 0 }).collect();
    m.create_job(
        j,
        addr(9),
        1,
        units,
        &sizing,
        1,
        0,
        1_000,
        ExposureInputs {
            q: 100,
            reprovision_allowance: 10,
            job_max_retention_files: 0,
            max_reassignments_per_file: 2,
            reassign_reimb: 5,
        },
        1_000_000,
    )
    .unwrap();

    m.publish_offer(offer(oid(3), addr(8), true)).unwrap();
    m.publish_offer(offer(oid(5), addr(7), false)).unwrap();
    m.reserve_capacity(oid(3), 1_000, 160).unwrap();

    for u in [uid(2), uid(3)] {
        let key = UnitKey::new(j, u);
        m.transition_unit(&key, UnitState::Eligible).unwrap();
        m.transition_unit(&key, UnitState::Assigned).unwrap();
        m.put_assignment(AssignmentIndexEntry {
            key: WorkItemKey::new(j, u, 0),
            winner_offer_bond_id: oid(3),
            winner_payment_addr: addr(0x50),
        })
        .unwrap();
    }
    m.accept_leaf(AcceptedLeaf {
        key: WorkItemKey::new(j, uid(2), 0),
        offer_bond_id: oid(3),
        commit_bond_id: CommitBondId::from_bytes([4; 32]),
        accepted_bytes: 100,
    })
    .unwrap();
    m.transition_unit(&UnitKey::new(j, uid(2)), UnitState::Accepted)
        .unwrap();
    m
}

/// Commit `after` as block `height` publishes it.
fn publish(
    db: &Database,
    before: Option<&ComputePoolModel>,
    after: &ComputePoolModel,
    height: u64,
) {
    let header = BlockHeader::new(
        Hash::hash(b"parent"),
        height,
        1_000 + height,
        Hash::hash(&height.to_be_bytes()),
        Hash::hash(b"root"),
        [0u8; 32],
    );
    let block = Block::new(header, Vec::new());
    let mut cand = CandidateExecution::new(db, 1 << 24);
    let journal = {
        let mut view = cand.view();
        let (mutated, journal) =
            ComputePoolStore::stage_transition(&mut view, before, after).unwrap();
        assert!(mutated > 0);
        journal
    };
    cand.finish_execution(
        ExecutionSubject::of(&block).unwrap(),
        block.header.state_root,
        Vec::new(),
        BlockJournals {
            account: JournalRecord::NothingToUndo,
            contract: JournalRecord::NothingToUndo,
            compute_pool: journal,
            beacon: JournalRecord::NothingToUndo,
        },
    )
    .accept_imported(&block)
    .unwrap()
    .publish()
    .unwrap();
}


use std::io::{Read, Write};

fn seeded_model() -> ComputePoolModel {
    let mut m = model();
    // An offer at the top of the u128 range, to exercise decimal parsing.
    let mut big = offer(oid(0x0B), addr(6), true);
    big.offered_bytes = u128::MAX;
    big.bond_locked = u128::MAX;
    m.publish_offer(big).unwrap();
    m.reserve_capacity(oid(0x0B), u128::MAX, u128::MAX - 5).unwrap();
    m
}

fn free_addr() -> std::net::SocketAddr {
    let l = std::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
    l.local_addr().unwrap()
}

/// One JSON-RPC call over plain HTTP/1.1; returns the response body verbatim.
fn http_post(addr: std::net::SocketAddr, body: &str) -> String {
    let mut s = std::net::TcpStream::connect(addr).unwrap();
    let req = format!(
        "POST / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: {addr}\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n{body}",
        body.len()
    );
    s.write_all(req.as_bytes()).unwrap();
    let mut raw = String::new();
    s.read_to_string(&mut raw).unwrap();
    let (head, rest) = raw.split_once("\r\n\r\n").expect("an HTTP response");
    assert!(head.starts_with("HTTP/1.1 200"), "{head}");
    assert!(!head.to_ascii_lowercase().contains("transfer-encoding: chunked"), "{head}");
    rest.to_string()
}

fn call(method: &str, params: serde_json::Value) -> String {
    serde_json::json!({ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": method, "params": params }).to_string()
}

async fn serve(srv: RpcServer) -> (std::net::SocketAddr, jsonrpsee::server::ServerHandle) {
    let a = free_addr();
    let h = srv.start(a).await.unwrap();
    (a, h)
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn generate() {
    let out = std::env::var("POOL_FIXTURE_OUT").ok();
    let ready = std::env::var("POOL_SERVE_READY").ok();
    if out.is_none() && ready.is_none() {
        return;
    }

    // Seeded state.
    let (srv, db, _d1) = server();
    publish(&db, None, &seeded_model(), 1);
    let (a1, h1) = serve(srv).await;

    if let Some(ready) = ready {
        std::fs::write(&ready, format!("http://{a1}")).unwrap();
        let stop = std::env::var("POOL_SERVE_STOP").expect("POOL_SERVE_STOP");
        for _ in 0..600 {
            if std::path::Path::new(&stop).exists() {
                break;
            }
            tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(1)).await;
        }
        h1.stop().unwrap();
        return;
    }
    let out = std::path::PathBuf::from(out.unwrap());
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&out).unwrap();

    // Fresh database: the production default, the pool gate closed.
    let (srv2, _db2, _d2) = server();
    let (a2, h2) = serve(srv2).await;
    // A database with one undecodable unit row.
    let (srv3, db3, _d3) = server();
    publish(&db3, None, &model(), 1);
    db3.put(cf::COMPUTE_POOL_STATE, &unit_key_bytes(&jid(1), &uid(3)), b"garbage")
        .unwrap();
    let (a3, h3) = serve(srv3).await;

    let unit = |j: u8, u: u8| call("pool_getUnit", serde_json::json!([hex32(j), hex32(u)]));
    let offer_q = |o: u8| call("pool_getOffer", serde_json::json!([hex32(o)]));
    let cases: Vec<(&str, std::net::SocketAddr, String)> = vec![
        ("unit_assigned", a1, unit(1, 3)),
        ("unit_accepted", a1, unit(1, 2)),
        ("unit_blocked_with_input", a1, unit(1, 4)),
        ("unit_not_held", a1, unit(1, 9)),
        ("offer_active_reserved", a1, offer_q(3)),
        ("offer_inactive", a1, offer_q(5)),
        ("offer_not_held", a1, offer_q(6)),
        ("offer_u128_max", a1, offer_q(0x0B)),
        ("unit_invalid_params", a1, call("pool_getUnit", serde_json::json!(["0x12", "0x34"]))),
        ("unit_gate_closed", a2, unit(1, 2)),
        ("offer_gate_closed", a2, offer_q(3)),
        ("unit_corrupt_row", a3, unit(1, 3)),
    ];
    for (name, a, req) in cases {
        let body = http_post(a, &req);
        std::fs::write(out.join(format!("{name}.request.json")), &req).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(out.join(format!("{name}.response.json")), &body).unwrap();
    }
    h1.stop().unwrap();
    h2.stop().unwrap();
    h3.stop().unwrap();
}
